# Questions to client — Session 1 (March 2026)

Answers will let us finalize the March MOR (the report is signed under penalty of perjury) and start
Session 2. Deliverables were completed with the assumptions flagged below; nothing was estimated to force
a balance.

1. **Pre-petition bank balance swept to the DIP account on 3/10/2026 — dollar amount?** Also confirm no
   estate cash sat in accounts outside the DIP account after the sweep. (Part 1 beginning/ending cash is
   currently computed assuming beginning cash of $0 — see `session1/march_mor_notes.md`.)
2. **Straddling payroll split:** of the $412,000 paid 3/13 for 2/28–3/13, how much is the pre-petition
   portion (services rendered 2/28–3/10) vs post-petition? Please confirm the pre-petition portion was paid
   under the wage-motion order (Dkt. 9) and within the $17,150 per-employee §507(a)(4) cap.
3. **Total liabilities subject to compromise:** please provide Schedules A/B/D or the claims register, so
   Part 2 LSTC covers all pre-petition claims, not just the $74,110 of trade claims visible in the March
   vendor file.
4. **Mesa returned-coils credit:** what does Mesa actually owe us for the returned coils (credit/AR
   balance)? We did NOT net it (prohibited, Dkt. 61 ¶3); once quantified it will be booked as a
   post-petition collection/receipt when collected.
5. **Mesa post-petition invoice 3/18 ($18,900):** confirm it was still unpaid at 3/31 (our file shows only
   Grainger 2,120 + Apex 9,800 + Front Range 7,650 = 19,570 paid). We recommend paying it — ordinary
   course (§503(b)(1)/§363(c)(1)).
6. **Dkt. 48 amendment:** do you want the noticed motion to add Mesa Steel to Schedule 1 and raise the
   $35,000 aggregate cap (only $3,800 remains after Apex)? If yes, please send the Denver Water contract
   exposure figures for the motion.
7. **UST quarterly fee:** confirm the 0.8% rate and the quarter/period covered; our accrual of
   0.8% × $490,770 = $3,926.16 is marked "estimate."
8. **H&P interim comp order entered 4/14 (80%/100% holdback):** please provide the application amount and
   any pre-petition retainer on hand, for the April MOR Part 5.
answer:
Mesa owes us about $11,000 for coils we returned in January. I figured we'd just net it.
For questions not answered above, the client has no additional information. Flag remaining unknowns explicitly.
